import uuid
import time

from fastapi import APIRouter
from fastapi.responses import JSONResponse

from .models import Run, RunCreate, ParticipantJoin
from .store import run_store
from .errors import ApiError

router = APIRouter()


@router.post("/runs", response_model=Run, status_code=201)
def post_runs(payload: RunCreate):
    if not payload.title or not str(payload.title).strip():
        raise ApiError("validation_error", "Title is required and cannot be empty")
    if not payload.datetime or not str(payload.datetime).strip():
        raise ApiError("validation_error", "Datetime is required and cannot be empty")
    if not payload.meeting_location or not str(payload.meeting_location).strip():
        raise ApiError("validation_error", "Meeting location is required and cannot be empty")

    run_id = str(uuid.uuid4())
    now = time.strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ", time.gmtime())

    run = Run(
        id=run_id,
        title=payload.title,
        datetime=payload.datetime,
        meeting_location=payload.meeting_location,
        distance=payload.distance,
        pace_target=payload.pace_target,
        route_notes=payload.route_notes,
        participants=[],
        created_at=now,
    )

    run_store[run_id] = run

    return JSONResponse(
        status_code=201,
        content={
            "id": run.id,
            "title": run.title,
            "datetime": run.datetime,
            "meeting_location": run.meeting_location,
            "distance": run.distance,
            "pace_target": run.pace_target,
            "route_notes": run.route_notes,
            "participants": run.participants,
            "created_at": run.created_at,
        },
    )


@router.get("/runs", response_model=list[Run])
def get_runs():
    return list(run_store.values())


@router.get("/runs/{run_id}", response_model=Run)
def get_runs_run_id(run_id: str):
    run = run_store.get(run_id)
    if run is None:
        raise ApiError("run_not_found", f"Run with id '{run_id}' not found")
    return run


@router.post("/runs/{run_id}/participants", response_model=Run, status_code=201)
def post_runs_run_id_participants(run_id: str, payload: ParticipantJoin):
    if not payload.name or not str(payload.name).strip():
        raise ApiError("validation_error", "Participant name is required and cannot be empty")

    run = run_store.get(run_id)
    if run is None:
        raise ApiError("run_not_found", f"Run with id '{run_id}' not found")

    name = payload.name.strip()
    for existing in run.participants:
        if existing.lower() == name.lower():
            raise ApiError("duplicate_participant", f"Participant '{name}' is already on this run")

    run.participants.append(name)
    run_store[run_id] = run

    return JSONResponse(
        status_code=201,
        content={
            "id": run.id,
            "title": run.title,
            "datetime": run.datetime,
            "meeting_location": run.meeting_location,
            "distance": run.distance,
            "pace_target": run.pace_target,
            "route_notes": run.route_notes,
            "participants": run.participants,
            "created_at": run.created_at,
        },
    )


@router.delete("/runs/{run_id}/participants/{participant_name}", response_model=Run)
def delete_runs_run_id_participants_participant_name(run_id: str, participant_name: str):
    if not participant_name or not participant_name.strip():
        raise ApiError("validation_error", "Participant name is required and cannot be empty")

    run = run_store.get(run_id)
    if run is None:
        raise ApiError("run_not_found", f"Run with id '{run_id}' not found")

    name = participant_name.strip()
    found = False
    remaining = []
    for p in run.participants:
        if p.lower() == name.lower():
            found = True
        else:
            remaining.append(p)

    if not found:
        raise ApiError("participant_not_found", f"Participant '{name}' not found on this run")

    run.participants = remaining
    run_store[run_id] = run

    return run
